title: Associate Director, AMI Curricula
description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Associate Director of AMI Curricula is responsible for the development of curricula across Allergan Medical Institute educational programs, primarily new large group programs in-field and in the Training Centers. Main responsibilities include collaboration with key stakeholders (AMI Programs team, Customer Marketing teams, Training Centers team, Design & Internal review team, etc) to develop content to achieve our educational objectives across the HCP learning journey.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned.):
Lead the development of AMI curricula across all large group programming in the AMI Training Centers and in-field programming
Strategic oversight of AMI content and tactics as it relates to large group programs, including: Net new program creation based on Learning Journey, business needs, market demand
Go to market strategy for new programs through Field and digital channels
Strategy for Faculty speaker training and selection, ongoing Faculty training post-launch
Oversight of development of all training materials, videos, slide decks, etc, aligning to brand strategy, KOL review, and adult learning principles
Curricula Lead for all internal Sales communications, including: Liaison between Curricula and Faculty Development team
Coordination of any new initiatives with Commercial Directors
Development of Field Resources (sales aids, targeting tools, etc)
Management of agency partners and content designers to ensure content adheres to creative and curricula briefs, brand guidelines, and MLRC review guidelines
Management of ‘Large Group/Training Center AMI pillar’ team members
Oversight of all workshop and agenda development
Responsible for capturing KOL advisor feedback across all programs
Translating key strategic initiatives into plans and go-to-market tactics for new AMI engagement programs
Coordinating cross-functional internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of AMI Engagement initiatives
Building and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs, thought leaders, and other key stakeholders
Coordinating with, and training HCP partners to ensure the execution of successful training programs
Perform other duties as assigned
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required.
Minimum of 10 years related experience is preferred.
Experience in curricula development
Experience on product/indication launches
Experience managing a team
Proficient with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Knowledge of FDA and regulatory statutes as applied to Allergan Aesthetics products, with the ability to function in an environment controlled by outside regulatory entities.
Knowledge of procedure training, consultation, business-to business (B2B) and selling skills are desired.
High degree of flexibility in adapting to a rapidly changing environment.
Occasional flexibility in work hours, including weekends, may be required.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Additional Requirements:
Ability to travel up to 40%. Evenings, overnight, weekends, domestic is required.
Language and Verbal Skills:
Individual must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Analytical and Reading Skills:
Ability to read, understand and abide by company procedures. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions and report on findings.

​The Manager, Strategic Initiatives combines strategic initiative management with advanced data analysis, dashboard analytics, and decision-support capabilities. The role translates complex portfolio, workforce, financial, resource, and operational data into clear insights that help leaders prioritize work, allocate resources, monitor execution, and make timely decisions. The position develops and maintains integrated dashboards, reporting tools, scorecards, and analytical views; strengthens data quality and governance across source systems; and supports cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption. The role works across CDO, R&D, Finance, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Procurement, and Business Technology Solutions to connect strategy, funding, capacity, execution risk, and measurable outcomes.​

Create concise, executive-ready narratives and presentations that connect data to business impact and enable leaders to distinguish priorities, understand implications, and make informed portfolio, funding, workforce, and execution decisions.
Provide end-to-end leadership for cross-functional process improvement and strategic initiatives, including scope definition, integrated plans, resource projections, governance, decision points, risk mitigation, change management, and implementation.
Facilitate initiative governance forums and working sessions; maintain clear documentation of decisions, actions, owners, milestones, and interdependencies; and escalate significant issues or resource gaps with fact-based options and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting, streamline manual workflows, improve data accessibility, and strengthen sustainable use of tools such as Power BI, Excel, SharePoint, Power Apps, Power Automate, Monday.com, and other approved platforms.
Develop, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators, success measures, forecasts, and effectiveness metrics for strategic initiatives and business operations; proactively identify material variances, emerging risks, and opportunities.
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree (or ex-US equivalent) in business, data analytics, information systems, engineering, life sciences, finance, operations, or a related field.
Minimum Experience: Typically 3+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical development, business operations, analytics, strategy, project or portfolio management, continuous improvement, consulting, or a related environment.
Demonstrated initiative, learning agility, and comfort working through ambiguity to structure problems and create scalable solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong project management, problem-solving, and continuous-improvement skills, including the ability to manage milestones, risks, dependencies, and competing priorities in a matrixed environment.
Experience developing and maintaining dashboards, scorecards, reports, or analytical products using Power BI, advanced Excel, or comparable data-visualization and business-intelligence tools.

title: Maintenance Optimization TPM, Availability Serviceability Team
description:
The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.
Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.
We are seeking a Maintenance Optimization Technical Program Manager to own how AWS data center infrastructure is maintained: which tasks, at what interval, with what controls, and why. The fleet runs thousands of preventive maintenance plans inherited from vendor manuals and historical practice. This role applies reliability-centered maintenance thinking to that inventory at fleet scale, deciding what each task protects against, whether the control fits the failure mode and its consequence, and where a human check can be replaced by telemetry or retired altogether.
Key job responsibilities
You will lead preventive maintenance optimization across equipment classes (electrical and mechanical), taking each change from failure-mode analysis through a revised maintenance standard to the published procedures technicians execute, with the labor and risk impact quantified. You will set the method: a repeatable, lightweight way to challenge a maintenance task (failure mode, consequence, existing detection, proposed control) that program managers across the team can run without you. Working with our monitoring, controls, and maintenance-planning teams, you will drive decisions on where remote telemetry can replace a physical inspection, removing a human check only when the data demonstrably covers it.
You will own decisions that most maintenance organizations never revisit. The problem is real engineering, not process administration: you will be asked why a task exists, what happens if it stops, and whether the data can prove it. You will work across EAM data, equipment telemetry, regulatory regimes, vendor warranty terms, and the physical gear itself, and you will do it inside the constraints of a live production fleet where being wrong has consequences. And you will build the capability in others. The TPMs you coach will carry this reasoning into every program they touch.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Preferred qualifications: - 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience applying reliability-centered maintenance methods (FMEA, task selection by failure mode and consequence, condition-based alternatives to calendar PMs) to a live fleet, including defending a change to an established maintenance standard.

You'll provide white glove technical support for Apple's most senior executives and high-profile external guests, and serve as a trusted technical partner across AppleTV, Music, and all of Services. This role requires deep expertise across AV infrastructure, broadcast engineering, live streaming technologies, multimedia productions as well as the ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and production teams to deliver seamless broadcast experiences.

5+ years experience in broadcast engineering, AV engineering, and live event production.
5+ years expertise supporting live broadcast environments including streaming, switching, and audio engineering with proficiency in production switchers such as Blackmagic ATEM or Sony MVS.
Preferred qualifications: 5+ years experience as a technical director, audio engineer, camera operator, mixer, and streaming engineer across in-person and remote production.
5+ years proficiency with streaming and web conferencing platforms including Zoom, WebEx, or Livestream.
5+ years experience supporting and maintaining enterprise conference room AV systems including Cisco, Crestron, and Dante audio networking.

5+ years hands-on experience with camera systems including Sony, Blackmagic, or PTZ systems and audio consoles such as Yamaha, Avid S6L, or Soundcraft.
5+ years experience with specialty room configurations including Casting Rooms, Pitch Rooms, and Screening Theaters.
Knowledge of video encoding and transcoding standards including H.264, H.265, and RTMP for live and on-demand delivery.

Experience troubleshooting complex AV and broadcast systems in live, high-pressure environments.

Proven ability to provide white-glove service in sensitive, high-visibility environments.

Background supporting studio production, casting sessions, or live content production.

Strong collaboration skills across engineering, creative, and production teams.

title: Pre-silicon Compute and ML Framework Manager
description:
Every iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV runs on the compute and graphics software foundation built by Apple’s Graphics, Games, and Machine Learning team. The Pre-silicon Compute Frameworks team sits at the leading edge of that work designing the Metal and Metal compute frameworks and validating performance for features that will define future Apple Silicon GPUs.
We’re looking for an engineering manager with a strong technical background who’s excited to build and lead a team of engineers, and to partner with software and hardware leaders to shape Apple's GPU compute roadmap!
As manager of the Pre-silicon Compute Frameworks team, you own the new APIs for Apple’s next GPU generations. You will lead, support, and grow a team of engineers building Metal and Metal compute framework features and conducting performance analysis on next generation GPU hardware, carrying features from emulation all the way through silicon and into the bring-up of new chips and products.
You will partner directly with leaders across Apple’s software and hardware organizations to propose, develop, and evaluate features for new silicon generations, representing Apple’s compute and ML roadmap while the hardware is still taking shape.
Minimum qualifications: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience
2-3 years of experience as a manager or lead
Experience with at least one GPU compute API (Metal, CUDA, OpenCL, or similar)
Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, and familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or CoreML
Knowledge of operating systems, computer architecture, and CPU/GPU programming, with experience in C/C++
Preferred qualifications: Experience defining, planning, and executing complex projects involving partnership across multiple teams
Track record in strategic leadership and decision-making
Familiarity with Apple framework and API design patterns
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or CoreML

title: Principal AI & Data Governance Architect
description:
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are building the machine learning lifecycle platform that powers generative AI features across Apple Services — from Music and TV+ to iCloud, App Store, and Sports. As these systems grow in scale and complexity, building them responsibly is as important as building them well.
We are looking for a AI & Data Governance Architect who can define and drive the governance and compliance architecture for our AI and ML platform — holistically, not piecemeal. This is not a role about enforcing rules from the sidelines. It is about getting deep into how data flows, how models are built, how systems interconnect, and designing the platform capabilities that ensure Apple meets its legal, regulatory, and ethical obligations at every layer. You will be the person who understands both the compliance landscape and the engineering reality — and who builds the bridge between them.
Minimum qualifications: Deep experience in data governance, ML governance, or compliance architecture within complex, large-scale technical environments.
Deep understanding of ML workflows, data engineering, and ML infrastructure — drive and provide feedback in design and architectural discussions.
Proven track record of working cross-functionally with legal, privacy, compliance, and engineering teams to define and implement governance solutions.
Demonstrated ability to refine legal and regulatory requirements into technical architecture and engineering deliverables.
Fluent in both legal and engineering languages — able to take prescriptive or loosely defined compliance obligations and translate them into precise technical requirements without losing the spirit of the original intent.
Experience engaging upstream with legal and policy stakeholders to shape policy guidance, ensuring that it is technically coherent.
Exceptional ability to operate in ambiguity — connecting requirements that don't come pre-connected, and driving clarity across organizations with different vocabularies and priorities.
Preferred qualifications: Familiarity with AI/ML regulatory frameworks and emerging legislation (e.g., EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA, data residency requirements).
Experience designing or implementing data classification systems, data catalogs, or model registries in a production ML environment.
Experience building governance frameworks for internal developer platforms or MLOps tooling.
Comfortable presenting complex compliance and architectural topics to senior and executive engineering and legal audiences.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar degree. Master's degree preferred.

title: Senior / Staff ML Engineer, Apple Data Platform
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer in Apple AI and Data Governance at Apple, you will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust solutions that ensure the ethical, secure, and compliant use of our data assets and AI systems. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise to build and maintain frameworks that uphold the integrity, privacy, and security of Apple’s AI initiatives while navigating complex regulatory environments. Your work will bridge technical innovation and compliance, ensuring that our AI technologies are responsibly managed throughout their lifecycle.
Are you passionate about building robust, ethical AI and data governance solutions from the ground up? Do you have the vision to tackle the complex challenges of AI data collection, usage, and regulatory compliance? If so, we want you on our team! In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of software engineers to architect Apple's next-generation AI and data governance platforms. You will drive the development of scalable systems that manage the entire machine learning lifecycle - ensuring our AI initiatives set the benchmark for privacy, compliance, and security and are grounded in strong data governance principles. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of ethical, responsible AI at Apple.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years experience in developing Data & AI governance software or integrating systems with governance systems.
Experience working with large data collection and processing systems.
Demonstrated proficiency in data management and building scalable systems that underpin AI applications.
Strong understanding of privacy and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, DMA) and how they apply to Data Governance and AI systems.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Preferred qualifications: Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams, including security, legal, privacy, compliance, and data engineering, to drive Data and AI governance initiatives.
Experience in designing and implementing robust data governance frameworks, policies, and standards that ensure the ethical and secure deployment of AI technologies.
A track record of identifying and mitigating risks in complex distributed data environments, with a focus on maintaining compliance in AI-driven projects.

Deep technical proficiency, with the ability to contribute to solution design and architecture decisions that produce extensible, operationally scalable experiences or platforms

title: Senior Security Engineer - Strategic Risk
description:
The Apple Services Engineering Security team builds and provides secure systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple’s services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, App Store, and Maps). As part of the ASE Security team, you will help manage the security needs of Apple’s services around the world. You will build and integrate the security controls, guardrails, and frameworks that help protect our customers data in Apple’s infrastructure. Your work will help build solutions to a variety of outstanding security risks to Apple systems and data. Join us, and you’ll play a meaningful role in ensuring the highest standard of security for one of the most-watched companies in the world.
In this role, you will be the primary security team point of contact for several large engineering efforts. You will work with engineering teams throughout their development lifecycle. You will conduct security reviews, post incident reviews, develop threat models, and use the insights from these engagements to build scalable methodologies. You will help define, automate and advocate for application level and platform-wide security improvements with a focus on risks to customer accounts and data. You will play a hands on role in ensuring that programs are reviewed, adjusted, implemented and tested appropriately.

Demonstrated ability to design, document, and implement new security processes

Expertise in threat modeling, operational threat intelligence, and common attack vectors and frameworks.

Experience with enterprise log collection and analysis platforms (e.g., Splunk, OSQuery)
Preferred qualifications: Experience with threat hunting, insider risk and/or investigations
Experience working with data engineers to define metrics and interpret results from detection and risk models
Experience in applying and experimenting with AI/ML, to solve security related use-cases

title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Datacenter Infrastructure Security
description:
We are the Foundational Security team in Apple Services Engineering (ASE). We secure the low-level foundations of Apple's datacenter fleet: hardware-backed trust, disk encryption, and the systems used to manage every server below the operating system.
We're looking for a senior engineer to take technical ownership of the platform that manages our baseboard management controllers. You'll set its engineering and security bar, shape how access is granted and verified, and lead its move toward modern, standards-based management. You'll work closely with datacenter operations, SRE, hardware, network and detection teams, and become the go-to expert on managing Apple's fleet securely.
This role owns the design, code and security of a privileged, availability-critical service. You'll write and review production code. You'll find and remove risk in how the service authenticates users, authorizes them and handles credentials, and you'll make privileged activity visible to the teams who detect misuse. You'll also help modernize how the fleet is managed, bringing along the many internal teams and tools that depend on the platform.
Over time, you'll help define what secure out-of-band management looks like at Apple. That includes how access is segmented across environments, how firmware is delivered and trusted, and what we require of management controllers in future hardware. It also includes how access should work when the requester is an automated system rather than a person.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of a production system or platform
Deep proficiency in Go, with 5+ years writing production Go code.
Experience building security telemetry for SIEM and detection pipelines (e.g., Splunk, OpenTelemetry)
Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization at scale, including PKI, mTLS, X.509 certificate identity and fine-grained access control
Experience with Swift, and Rust
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with server management technologies such as IPMI, DMTF Redfish, OpenBMC, or vendor BMCs (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC)
Experience finding and fixing security flaws in networked services through code review, threat modeling or security testing
A track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions and cross-team migrations, mentoring engineers, and explaining security trade-offs to engineers and leadership
Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, and with running PostgreSQL in production
Experience managing the lifecycle of secrets and credentials at fleet scale, including rotation and emergency access
Experience building and operating highly available, distributed services that other teams depend on
Familiarity with network segmentation and zero-trust access patterns, such as identity-aware proxies
Knowledge of firmware security, including secure boot, firmware signing and updates, TPMs and hardware roots of trust
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants on a production codebase

title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools - Media, Graphics & Compute Tech
description:
The Media, Graphics & Compute Technologies (MGC) organization serves as the foundation for audio and video media across Apple’s diverse range of innovative products, including iPhones, HomePods, AppleTVs, Apple Watches, iPads, Macs, Vision Pros, and professional and consumer applications such as Final Cut, Music, TV, and iWork. MGC elevates the media experience on iOS, tvOS, watchOS, macOS, and visionOS platforms through technologies like AVFoundation, CoreMedia, CoreAudio, Media Toolbox, and Video Toolbox.
This position is with the Streaming Media Ecosystem (SME) team, which delivers a comprehensive set of streaming technologies, ensuring seamless media experiences for Apple and third-party services. The services SME supports include Apple TV, Apple Music, Disney Plus, Netflix, and HBO. This role focuses on designing and developing applications, services, and platform infrastructure that support SME’s products and features. This work plays a critical role in ensuring product quality by building the tooling and automation frameworks that enable rapid, reliable delivery of world-class streaming experiences.
We’re looking for a meticulous, focused, and self-motivated individual, passionate about automating workflows, including through GenAI and agentic tooling. You’ll partner with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to improve their efficiency.
You’ll join a team of engineers building scalable applications that help a large engineering organization ship higher-quality software, faster.
You’ll design reliable, highly available applications, services, and platforms, with automation as the guiding goal.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years of software development experience, with strong proficiency in Python or a similar language
Demonstrated expertise in debugging complex systems
Experience architecting and implementing large-scale distributed systems
Preferred qualifications: Proficiency in multiple programming languages
Familiarity with application performance profiling and benchmarking
Hands-on experience building applications or developer tooling that leverage GenAI technologies, such as LLM APIs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

title: Sr. ML Production Model Automation Engineer, Siri Speech
description:
Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be.
As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next-generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up. Your work will have direct, meaningful impact for users across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS.
This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and human-centered design, shipping technology that is centered around users and their needs.
We are the team building products for voice, dictation and other audio products at Apple. These are multimodal models that power Siri on-device speech features, and the next generation of audio experiences across our platforms. Our researchers and modeling engineers train models, iterate on data mixtures spanning conductor backed Siri telemetry to synthetic voice corpora, and stack supervised fine-tuning, LoRA adapter training, and reinforcement learning into pipelines that produce the adapters, tokenizers and detokenizers.
You’ll join a small group of production automation engineers whose mandate is to turn the operational substrate underneath foundation model training into a reliable, observable, self-serve system. The work spans python, shell tooling, cloud platform integration, internal CLI design, and close partnership with the product and research teams you are enabling.
Minimum qualifications: Strong software engineering fundamentals; comfortable in Python and Bash, comfortable reading and refactoring large internal codebases.
5+ years experience in Machine Learning Operations.
Production experience with one or more cloud ML platforms (GCP TPU, AWS GPU clusters, Kubernetes-backed training infra) including submitting jobs, debugging schedulers, working around quota systems.
Familiarity with the ML training lifecycle: data preprocessing pipelines, distributed training, checkpoint formats, multi-slice / multi-region considerations.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code, CLI tool design, and developer ergonomics. You've shipped tools that other engineers actually use.
Bias toward observability and reliability.
Comfortable working across team boundaries: you'll partner with researchers, product and infra teams.
Preferred qualifications: Bachelors degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical discipline
Hands-on with JAX, XLA, or large-model training stacks or equivalent.
Experience with multi-slice TPU training and cross-region GCS / S3-compatible storage.
Background in MLOps tools: model registries, feature stores, experiment trackers, reward-model serving for RL.
Prior work simplifying onboarding and access provisioning (Apple Access Manager, AWS IAM at scale, or equivalent).
Experience writing Claude Code / agent skills, runbooks, or other LLM-assisted developer tooling.

Applied Machine Learning practitioner

title: Environmental Health & Safety Professional
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is seeking a EH&S Professional to support our field operations teams in Texas. As an EHS Professional, you will perform hazard assessments, incident investigations, work through employees’ safety concerns and issues, as well as strategize with site leaders to prevent/reduce injuries. In addition, you will ensure environmental compliance with all local, state, and federal regulatory requirements applicable to these departments.

What You’ll Do

 - Develop and maintain compliance with all applicable regulations and/or guidelines established by Texas Health and Safety Codes, OSHA, NFPA, NIOSH

 - Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures

 - Execute industrial hygiene studies to analyze manufacturing byproducts against associated human health thresholds

 - Inspect facilities, machinery, and safety equipment in order to identify and correct potential hazards, and implement machine guarding when needed

 - Complete and maintain documented safety observations from regular hazard identification audits

 - Investigate industrial accidents, injuries, or occupational diseases to determine root causes, corrective actions and preventive measures

 - Develop safety solutions to resolve EHS hazards/ concerns within cost and schedule constraints following a safety order of precedence to include elimination, substitution, engineering controls, work practice controls, training, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure that safety of personnel, property, and the environment are within acceptable risk boundaries

 - Responsible for hazardous and non-hazardous waste management


What You’ll Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering with an emphasis in occupational health and safety and/or environmental engineering

 - 3+ years of experience in the design, development and operational oversight of environmental, health and safety disciplines

 - Demonstrated ability to research and apply the best industrial and working practices to provide effective services

 - Knowledge of process safety management methods, pressure systems, and chemical delivery systems

 - Strong knowledge and experience in interpreting, applying and documenting federal, state and local safety and environmental regulations

 - Experience with emergency response communication and incident management in incidents involving hazardous and non-hazardous material releases to air, soil, and water


About the Team
The Environmental Health & Safety team is responsible for building and maintaining a culture where safety is embedded into every aspect of our operations. We partner closely with field, warehouse, manufacturing, and leadership teams to proactively identify risks, implement practical safety solutions, and ensure compliance across a rapidly growing operation.

As Base continues to scale, the EHS team plays a critical role in protecting our employees, customers, and communities while enabling the business to move quickly and efficiently. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on team that values ownership, continuous improvement, and a proactive approach to solving complex safety and environmental challenges. If you're excited about building programs from the ground up, influencing operational excellence, and making a tangible impact on employee safety, you'll thrive here.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT
Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets

Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.
Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.

Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

About the Role
The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. This role acts as the single-threaded owner for SMB onboarding, ensuring merchants are launched quickly, accurately, and with minimal friction through data-driven insights, process automation, and clear ownership alignment.

Process Visibility & SLA Tracking: Build dashboards to monitor true onboarding timelines, identify delays, and surface insights to inform process and tooling improvements.
Root Causing Blocked Cases: Develop a shared tracker for blocked cases, analyze trends, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and implement sustainable fixes.
Integrations Enablement: Design and refine onboarding workflows for new integration types (e.g., Shopify), and establish scalable processes as SMB Retail expands in 2026.
Product & Tooling Guidance: Translate workflow gaps into actionable product requirements for systems like SFDC, and advocate for automation that reduces manual work.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with MXO, GTMT, IA, Sales, and Product to ensure end-to-end alignment on onboarding priorities and execution.
Data & Insights: Create and maintain onboarding performance dashboards to measure success and track progress toward SLAs and OKRs.

Drive meaningful impact by transforming how SMB merchants onboard — reducing friction, accelerating launch timelines, and improving the overall merchant experience.

About the Team
The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. As Head of First Party Chip Finance, you will be the finance leader for OpenAI’s custom silicon efforts. You will partner with teams across chip design, engineering, infrastructure, supply chain, and finance to turn technical roadmaps into sound investment decisions and financially disciplined execution.

This role spans the full chip development lifecycle: evaluating design and roadmap choices, building investment cases, forecasting development and production costs, and supporting manufacturing and deployment at scale. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Effective communication, consulting, coaching and facilitation skills.

title: Senior Corporate Counsel - Litigation
location: Northbrook, IL, United States; Chicago, IL, United States
description:
This role is hybrid on-site (3) days a week in Northbrook or Chicago, IL
As a member of the Legal team, the Senior Counsel – Litigation and Disputes is a core member of UL Solutions’ legal function. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel, Litigation and Disputes, the Senior Counsel – Litigation and Disputes will work closely with the Chief Legal Office (CLO) and UL Solutions’ corporate and business leadership to coordinate and assist on the following matters.
Manage and support all aspects of potential, threatened, and active litigation matters for the company, in areas that include commercial litigation, product incidents, customer and supplier disputes, regulatory matters, and subpoenas.
Develop recommendations for the most effective strategy for defense or prosecution of these matters.
Support the preparation of company staff for legal proceedings, depositions and trial, and represent the company at trials, mediations, arbitrations, administrative hearings, and depositions.
Advise the company on litigation risk and strategy.
Oversee internal discovery efforts with or without outside counsel, including coordination with internal e-discovery team about document identification, searching, collection, and production.
Lead and supervise investigations in connection with a wide range of legal issues to identify problems and to support pending and potential litigation, investigations, and regulatory enforcement.
Assist with subpoena responses and other third-party requests for information.
Assist with periodic reporting on litigation matters.
Coordinate within CLO and support the development, revision and maintenance of both internal CLO and enterprise-wide procedures on matters related to dispute and litigation proceedings.
Support the development, revision, implementation and maintenance of policies, procedures, and technical and organizational controls to ensure the company’s compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Coordinate on the management external counsel, as necessary, in a cost-effective manner and in accordance with CLO Billing guidelines.
Coordinate third-party vendors retained by UL on any litigation or dispute matters.
Perform other legal duties as directed by the Associate General Counsel or other CLO leadership.
JD degree and a minimum of 7 years relevant experience in a law firm or fast-paced and innovative corporate legal department
Bar admission in good standing
In-depth knowledge of laws and regulations
Experience in the following legal areas strongly preferred: product liability; commercial and contract disputes; securities litigation
Experience in taking and defending depositions, preparing witnesses, and attending hearings and trials
Strong analytical and organizational skills and excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to use sound judgment, provide guidance, and make key decisions in a demanding and fast-paced environment
Ability to contribute as a team player and work collaboratively with colleagues, clients, and business leaders to fulfill and advance company strategy
Ability to multi-task and organize workflow independently in response to the company's strategic priorities and objectives
Willingness to travel
What you’ll experience working for ULS
UL Solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. From day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. Our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. We break things, burn things and blow things up. All in the name of safety science.
That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. It takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. It takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.
This is more than a job. It’s a calling. A passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. As a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.
Everyone here is unique. But we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. Join UL Solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.
Empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. It means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. At UL Solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.
Join UL Solutions to be at the center of safety. To learn more about us and the work we do, visit   UL.com

title: Quality and Safety Manager
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.
As a Quality & Safety Manager you will play a crucial role in ensuring the highest levels of safety, service quality, and operational efficiency for our transit services. You will be responsible for supervising and training drivers, managing on-the-road performance, responding to incidents, and maintaining service standards. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in dynamic environments and are committed to fostering a culture of safety and excellence.
**This is an in-person position with the expectation that you will be in the field 5 days per week weekend included**
What You’ll Do:
Conduct on-the-road supervision, including ride-alongs and shadowing, to ensure compliance with safety and service standards.
Monitor and evaluate driver interactions and adherence to safety protocols, providing constructive feedback and coaching.
Partner with the Field Manager to provide continuous training, including initial, remedial, and refresher courses.
Deliver hands-on coaching on best practices, safety procedures, and service expectations.
Lead post-accident and post-incident protocols, serving as the Designated Employer Representative (DER) for DOT compliance.
Act as the primary point of contact for urgent operational issues, implementing real-time solutions to ensure service continuity.
Review and assess complaint reports, driver feedback, and training session documentation.
Conduct training needs assessments and implement necessary improvements.
85% on-the-road supervision, 15% training and administrative duties.
Who You Are:
Experience in transit supervision, transportation management, or a similar field preferred.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor and guide drivers.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to make quick, effective decisions in dynamic situations.
Strong communication skills for effective feedback delivery and conflict resolution.
Knowledge of DOT regulations, safety standards, and ADA/paratransit compliance is a plus.
Compensation and Benefits:
Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
Salary: $21-23 / hour
